## Two New Team-Building Activities

### 1. Escape Room Challenge

* Book an escape room session for the team
* Set a time limit (e.g. 60 minutes)
* Divide the team into smaller groups (3-4 people)
* Each group must solve puzzles and challenges to escape the room
* The team that escapes the fastest wins

This activity encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and communication under pressure

### 2. Volunteer Day

* Organize a volunteer day at a local charity or community center
* Assign team members to different volunteer roles (e.g. serving food, cleaning, etc.)
* Set a time limit (e.g. 3 hours)
* The team earns points for each volunteer hour completed

This activity fosters empathy, community spirit, and a sense of social responsibility
